groups.sentence: Administrators provide information about the environmental cost of AI models and may publish estimates.
Students are told at course start that technology and AI use choices carry environmental and societal implications.
Instructors may state that environmental concerns justify not using AI tools in their courses.
Everyone considers environmental impact and uses the most efficient or sustainable AI tools and models for the task.
Administrators audit the institution's own AI footprint over time.
AI use consumes significant energy, water and other resources, with negative environmental impacts and carbon costs.
Students are aware of the environmental cost of AI and weigh it when deciding whether and how to use AI.
Administrators consider, understand, measure and limit the environmental costs of AI, including in technology evaluation and sustainability plans.
A search engine or other tools have a lighter environmental footprint than a chatbot.
Instructors use AI judiciously and purposefully rather than casually.
